claims.text: The proposed model combines a gating mechanism with tensor products to enhance learning of long-term dependencies and improve interactions between input and hidden layers.
By integrating the gating mechanism from LSTMRNN and GRURNN with tensor products, the model can learn temporal and sequential data more effectively than standard RNNs.
The architecture allows for direct interaction between input and hidden layers through a bilinear form, reducing parameters while maintaining performance.
